friction: No batch marking: each hand-in is opened, scored and saved one at a time; 'Out of' defaults to 10 and is not remembered per homework
suggested_fix: Add 'Full marks' shortcut, remember Out-of per homework, allow marking from the list row

friction: Hand-ins, written quiz answers and placement papers are three separate marking places with two different UIs
suggested_fix: One 'Mark queue' listing all three kinds

friction: 'Overdue homework' row goes to the Homework tab which auto-selects 'To mark', so overdue items are not shown; nothing to chase or remind
suggested_fix: Pass a filter (assigned+overdue) with the tab jump; add a 'Remind' action on overdue rows

friction: Badge '23 things' adds papers, child-homework pairs and people; written count can under-report (300-attempt slice)
suggested_fix: Pass ?status=pending_marking; count one unit

friction: 'Needs a nudge' row's chip says 'Assign' and only jumps to the Homework tab (no form, no student); does not help contact the child or parent
suggested_fix: Open a prefilled message to that child; rename chip to 'Message'

friction: Only a blank message into the child's thread; no kind template and no visible statement that the parent is told
suggested_fix: Prefilled friendly check-in text and 'Parent is notified' line

friction: 'Quiet for 14+ days' opens Students unfiltered; no highlight of the quiet children
suggested_fix: Filter/highlight the quiet students on arrival

friction: 'Quiet'/'Needs a nudge' label reads blame-y; 'quiet' includes kids who never opened assigned work
suggested_fix: Neutral wording ('Check in') and correct definition

friction: 4 vanity stat tiles and lede push Next lesson and Attention down (about 90 words) at 6:55pm
suggested_fix: Hide/collapse tiles on Home by default; put Next lesson first

friction: 'Start lesson' only switches to the Live tab; 3-4 taps to be in the room; no per-student prep (last score, homework status)
suggested_fix: Open the Lobby directly; show 1 line per student

friction: 35-40 s to first content, 'Checking access...' then skeleton; each tab switch shows a skeleton again (only Lessons stays mounted)
suggested_fix: Cache last Home data; stale-while-revalidate per tab

friction: Search returns 6 titles only, no year/subject/topic; cannot verify Year 4/5; no 'show more'

friction: Quiz search has no year filter; dropdown shows title + question count only; no preview inside the form

friction: Full form uses a native date input (default 7 days); 'Tomorrow' chips exist only in the lesson mini-form

friction: Nine fields, two similar lesson searches ('Base it on a lesson' vs 'Link lessons (optional)'); about 200 words of labels
suggested_fix: Fold optional fields under 'More options'

friction: When a group already has homework the big tile opens the existing list; creating needs the small '+' (icon only)

friction: Mini-form picks students individually (yearGroup null): no group chip, no 'all Year N'

friction: Subject, pass mark, timer, audience and retakes (about 250 words) come before the question picker; questions are below the fold

friction: Reuse is one '+ Add' tap per question; no multi-select, no random pick, no '10 of 10' counter; rows show prompt only

friction: No Duplicate/Copy quiz; 'Edit existing' edits the original in place, risking a live quiz

friction: Question form opens as a modal over the builder modal; about 8 actions per multiple-choice question; new question has no year so year filter hides it; draft questions block publish only at save
suggested_fix: Inline row-add in the builder; default year from the quiz; auto-publish

friction: Flashcards assigned immediately with no due date; student picker has no year shortcut; tile disappears silently when topic has 0 cards

friction: Worksheet has its own 'Set worksheet as homework' button only when the lesson has one; 'Set homework' tile assigns the lesson not the worksheet; Home tile says 'Worksheets 1'

friction: Select lists every topic in the account (about 2,457) alphabetically; homework pack ignores worksheetAssessmentId

friction: Curriculum heat-map card sits above the search/year filter and pushes the list down

friction: Unread messages shown only as a badge on the 11th tab (clipped on desktop, off-screen on phone); Home does not mention them

friction: Three nested accordions (student, lesson, thread) and one-line previews; about 3 taps to open each thread; opening marks read with no 'mark unread'

friction: Below 1024 px the thread pane renders under the entire folder list, no scroll-into-view

friction: No quick replies (unlike MarkDialog chips); tab label 'Student message centre' is long

friction: About 120 of 155 catalogue tiles are greyed 'In build'/'Coming soon'; clicking one just logs interest; 'Ready to use only' is off by default

friction: Tools is tab 9 of 11 with a generic label and fallback sparkle icon; not discoverable and cannot attach a tool to a student or homework

friction: 'Set homework' is both the primary button and the name of a list view (assignments) next to Inbox
